fields.Group: stitch QSPI_IO1 hop, ADC_SCKI via A
stitch QSPI_IO1, IO2, NCS hops, flash end

texts.text: A. Compute core: U1 and its decoupling, HSE, reset, BOOT0, user LED
B. Power entry: USB-C, ESD, 5 V mux, 3V3 buck, 3V3A LDO, VBUS sense, power LED
C. Settings store: QSPI NOR for the EEPROM emulation
D. Audio out: PCM5102A, OUTL leaves on DAC_OUTL, OUTR unused
Supply flags: nets fed through passives or from the connector
F. Audio in: PCM1808 on SAI1 block B, slave on BCLK/LRCLK. VINL/VINR arrive AC-coupled from the top sheet
U8 AGND and DGND both on GND. VCC from 5VA through R20
Clock source series R at U1
G. Reference-transition stitching, 10 nF 3V3-GND, one per via group:
C56 U1-east I2S escapes; C57 U6-west I2S rises; C58 ADC_DOUT rise;
C59 QSPI_IO1 hop, ADC_SCKI via A; C60 QSPI_IO1, IO2, NCS hops, flash end; C61 ADC_SCKI via B
